visual_description: A mid‑day office scene bathed in soft natural light from a window. A gender‑neutral civil servant sits at a wooden desk, turned slightly toward a laptop. The laptop’s screen shows the Egyptian government portal’s vacancy‑search page, but the results area is empty, indicating the absence of a central job announcement. In front of the laptop lies a printed appointment document with a conspicuous red “Pending” stamp and a highlighted note that reads “No funded vacancy.” The employee’s right hand hovers over the mouse, eyes focused on the screen as if scrutinizing the missing posting. The camera is positioned at eye level, slightly to the right of the desk, using a shallow depth of field that keeps the laptop screen and the stamped document sharp while the background office shelves fade softly. The overall lighting is even, with gentle shadows that convey a calm, investigative atmosphere.
